title: Autopilot
guidance: Provide an outline (one chapter per line) and start: explore & pick → generate → review → rewrite (≤ N rounds) → pass or archive as degraded. Fully unattended ("Stop" is the only manual action).
outlinePlaceholder:
One chapter per line, optionally "Title: beats"; e.g.
Chapter 1: two strangers meet in a ruined temple
Chapter 2: the lighthouse in the mist gorge goes dark
pauseHint: The default policy is "pause + notify" (your verdict is preserved): conflicts are persisted with an audit trail; you may authorize auto-ignore and resume from the breakpoint, or resolve them one by one in the Consistency tab.
resumeHint: {{count}} unfinished run(s) found (resume from the breakpoint after a trip/abort; finished chapters are not re-run).
guideSettings: Configure a model and store an API key in Settings first
